content:
The next major iPhone software version is iOS 27, coming soon. Here is the expected public release timeline for iOS 27.

iOS 27 will launch in September, likely mid-month.

iOS 27 is the next major software version for iPhone, and has been in beta testing all summer.

After months of beta testing, Apple traditionally rolls out its new major iOS update to all users in September.

Therefore, iOS 27's release date is expected in September, likely mid-month.

Below are the past few years of iOS release dates from Apple:

  • iOS 26: September 15 (Monday)
  • iOS 18: September 16 (Monday)
  • iOS 17: September 18 (Monday)
  • iOS 16: September 12 (Monday)

Based on this pattern, iOS 27 is expected to launch on or around September 14 (Monday).

The official date is typically announced during Apple's annual iPhone event, which is generally held about a week before the release. iPhone 18 Pro is currently expected to be unveiled on or around September 9.

iOS 27 brings new features to apps like Wallet, Photos, Messages, and Notes, along with upgrades to CarPlay and AirPods, and of course includes a major overhaul of Siri AI, among other things.

This update will be compatible with all iPhone models supported by iOS 26.

Which new features and changes in iOS 27 are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments section.
